label: Princess Fiona
description: Princess, ogre, kung fu expert, and she rescues herself.
direction: Speak in Princess Fiona's warm, confident voice: bright and regal but down to earth, wry and a little feisty, with a smile in it. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: DreamWorks Animation (film based on the 1990 book Shrek! by William Steig)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character was created for the 2001 film and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a film performance, and Shrek is a live trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Shrek name, which are live DreamWorks trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Not far now. Hang in there.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Stay sharp.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Still closer than Far Far Away.
lines.start_drive_1: Hi, I'm Fiona. Princess, ogre, and your navigator.
lines.start_drive_2: Alright, let's go. And nobody ask Donkey for directions.
lines.start_drive_3: Rescue yourself, that's my motto. Let's drive!
lines.start_drive_4: Out of the tower and onto the road. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_5: Shrek's minding the babies, so I'm navigating today.
lines.start_drive_6: Good morning! Even the birds are singing. Let's roll.
lines.start_drive_7: Don't worry, I know a few kung fu moves. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_8: Off to Far Far Away? Or somewhere closer. Let's ride.
lines.start_drive_9: Ogres have layers, and so do road trips. Here we go!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Even fairy tales take detours.
lines.arrived: We're here! And they lived happily ever after.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Hi yah!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. The royal tour.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Typical. Still quicker than a dragon's keep.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careful now. Slow and steady.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Eyes open, princess.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Even royalty follows the rules.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Wait for green, my knight.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. The royal guard is on duty. Nice and easy.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it? No problem. This princess rescues herself. New route!
